items.question: Under what condition must a hundred-thousand measure situated in the forehead-syllable mass be offered by one who has acted in relation to the god-worshipped object?
premises: A measure rests in the forehead-syllable mass as given.
A hundred-thousand count is specified for that measure.
The action of completion bears on what is offered to the god-worshipped one.
items.inference: The hundred-thousand measure located in the forehead-syllable mass is to be assigned in the context of one who has acted for the god-worshipped.
uncertainties: The syntactic link between kṛtya and the preceding tokens remains unclear from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: One who has acted offers a hundred-thousand, situated in the mass of forehead syllables, to the god-worshipped.
